description: Electricians fit and repair electrical circuits and wiring systems. They also install and maintain electrical equipment and machinery. This work can be performed indoors as well as outdoors, in nearly every type of facility.

essential_skills.preferred_label: react to events in time-critical environments
follow health and safety procedures in construction

optional_skills.preferred_label: use diagnostic tools for electronic repairs
use specialised tools in electric repairs

description: Electricity distribution workers construct and maintain electric power transmission and distribution systems. They maintain and repair powerlines, compliant with safety regulations.

optional_skills.preferred_label: follow safety procedures when working at heights
ensure compliance with electricity distribution schedule
enforce safety procedures when working at heights
assess areas for power line installation

description: Household appliances repair technicians use electrical equipment to test resistance or voltage and to identify appliances' malfunctions. They repair small and large electrical or gas home appliances such as vacuum cleaners, washing machines, dishwashers, air conditioners and refrigerators.

essential_skills.preferred_label: provide customer information related to repairs
use diagnostic tools for electronic repairs
manufacturer's instructions for electrical household appliances

optional_skills.preferred_label: perform services in a flexible manner
prepare warranty documents for electrical household appliances
sell service contracts for electrical household appliances
explain features of electrical household appliances
advise customers on electrical household appliances' installation

description: Lift engineers set lifts into a prepared framed hoistway. They install support assembly, set up the lift pump or motor, piston or cable, and mechanism. Lift engineers connect the necessary electronic elements to complete the installation and connection of the lift cabin. They also perform the necessary steps to inspect and repair lifts, as well as the shaft and any associated electronics. Lift engineers make sure every inspection and report action is noted in a log book, and report to the client on the state of the serviced lift.

essential_skills.preferred_label: follow health and safety procedures in construction

optional_skills.preferred_label: guide operation of heavy construction equipment
assist people trapped in confined spaces
provide customer information related to repairs
follow safety procedures when working at heights

description: Marine electricians install, maintain and repair electrical and electronic systems in vessels such as air conditioning systems, lamps, radios, heating systems, batteries, electrical wiring and alternators. They use diagnostic testing equipment to inspect vessels and find faults. To do repair work, they use hand tools and specialised electrical instruments and machines.

optional_skills.preferred_label: maintain vessel technical equipment according to instructions
follow control of substances hazardous to health procedures

description: Electrical mechanics install, repair and maintain mechanical and electrical components of machinery, tools and equipment. They test electrical parts to ensure efficiency and make improvements accordingly.

Wind turbine technicians maintain and repair wind turbines by performing diagnostic inspections, analysing faults, and performing repair duties. They ensure the wind turbines operate in compliance with regulations, and assist the wind engineers in the construction of wind turbines. Wind turbine technicians may also test and install hardware and software components of wind turbines.

essential_skills.preferred_label: follow safety procedures when working at heights

optional_skills.preferred_label: ensure compliance with electricity distribution schedule

description: Rolling stock electricians install, maintain and repair electrical and electronic systems in rail vehicles such as air conditioning systems, lamps, heating systems, electrical wiring etc. They use diagnostic testing equipment to inspect vehicles and find faults. To do repair work, they use hand tools and specialised electrical instruments and machines.

essential_skills.preferred_label: install electronic communication devices on trains

optional_skills.preferred_label: follow control of substances hazardous to health procedures
detect malfunctions in train control systems
use specialised tools in electric repairs
use diagnostic tools for electronic repairs
position vehicles for maintenance and repair

description: Automotive battery technicians assemble, install, inspect, maintain and repair batteries in motor vehicles. They use electrical test equipment to confirm good working condition after installation. They evaluate batteries to determine the nature of power problems. They also prepare old batteries for disposal.

Ride technicians work to maintain and repair amusement park attractions. They need a strong technical knowledge and have specialised knowledge of the rides they are assigned to maintain. Ride technicians usually keep records of the maintenance and repairs performed as well as uptime and downtime for each serviced attraction. Attention to safety is especially important in the maintenance and repair of amusement park rides.

essential_skills.preferred_label: ensure health and safety of visitors
ensure health and safety of staff

description: Power tool repair technicians identify defects and repair electrically powered tools such as drills, chainsaws, lawn mowers and grinding machines. They disassemble, test and replace defective parts in tools. Power tools repair technicians advise customers on maintenance products and methods for their equipment. They may sell such products.

essential_skills.preferred_label: provide customer information related to repairs
use specialised tools in electric repairs

description: Ground lighting officers carry out the inspection and maintenance of airports' lighting systems. They record their findings and formulate the actions to be followed.

essential_skills.preferred_label: exert a goal-oriented leadership role towards colleagues
ensure functionality of airport lighting systems
develop work plans to solve problems
supervise routine maintenance of airport lighting systems
